rule: Frozen acceptance thresholds. Authored by the ticket owner before the first implementation commit; changing any value after the first recorded result requires a new ticket and a full gate restart. Hard gates exit non-zero; soft thresholds are reported with numerator/denominator and strata.

paired_comparison.methods: exact McNemar for hit/no-hit; paired bootstrap (10000 permutations, 95% CI) for nDCG@10
paired_comparison.winner_rule: positive median difference with CI excluding zero

notes: Recall/nDCG thresholds are baseline-floor anchors for the frozen synthetic corpus, not production external-validity claims. Hypothesis classification/falsifiability are measured on the labeled set with results reported; no pass/fail threshold is asserted at 1.0.0 because the label set is authored alongside the implementation (NOT_CALIBRATED, inherited limit).
